name: Tailwindadmin
summary: Free open-source admin dashboard template built with React and Tailwind CSS, with shadcn/ui versions for five frameworks.
description: Admin dashboard template for dashboards, SaaS apps, CRM systems and internal tools, built on Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui components on Radix. Ships versions for Next.js, React, Angular 21, Vue and TanStack Start, pre-designed pages (dashboard, login, register, user profile, tables, charts, error pages), sidebar/topbar layouts and optional dark mode.
contains: free open-source Tailwind CSS admin dashboard template
versions for Next.js, React, Angular 21, Vue and TanStack Start
pre-designed pages: dashboard, login, register, user profile, tables, charts, error pages
shadcn/ui components on Radix with Tailwind theming
sidebar, topbar and page layout structures
charts built with ApexCharts; Iconify icons
